biotools.summary: OralImmunoAnalyser is a software tool developed by the University of Santiago de Compostela for quantitative immunohistochemical assessment of oral leukoplakia, specifically estimating ki67 expression through image segmentation and classification models. It aims to reduce expert analysis time and improve reproducibility compared to manual counting.
